method: Three separate Chrome launches per route with fresh temporary profiles and the default simulated-mobile preset, using isolated rebuilt production copies. This is a diagnostic experiment, not accepted-source evidence.
experiment: Keep snap wrappers in the initial render, omit full card content for inactive clips, and render active plus adjacent card contents after hydration.
conclusion: The experiment reduced raw HTML by 13244 bytes but did not improve simulated LCP and was not integrated. Run-to-run variation is substantial: the fresh baseline median differs from the previously accepted source-build median of 2625.511 ms. The playback/navigation/end journey passed; a media-deferral regression expected an offscreen img placeholder removed by the experiment. Workspace source was unchanged.
